meta.name: Monitor product prices and stock with Google Sheets, OpenAI, and Slack

name: Price & Stock Monitor → Slack + Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Price & Stock Monitor → Slack + Google Sheets

### How it works

This workflow runs every six hours, reads a Google Sheets product watchlist, and checks each product one at a time. For each item, it retrieves the product page, handles fetch/API failures with a Slack alert, otherwise cleans the HTML and uses an extraction model to identify current price and stock status. It compares the extracted values to the stored watchlist values, posts Slack notifications when a price or availability change is detected, then updates the Google Sheets row before continuing the loop.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger interval if six-hour checks are not desired.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and select the spreadsheet, sheet, and columns used for the product watchlist, including URL, product name, last price, and last availability.
- Configure the product page snapshot/fetch node with the required API credentials or service settings.
- Connect OpenAI credentials for the extraction model used by the information extractor.
- Connect Slack credentials and set the destination channels for change alerts and failure alerts.
- Verify the code and set nodes reference the correct field names from the watchlist and extraction output.

### Customization

Adjust the watchlist columns, extraction prompt/schema, comparison logic, and Slack message templates to match different product sites or alert thresholds.

## Schedule watchlist read

Starts the workflow on a six-hour schedule and loads the product watchlist rows from Google Sheets.

## Loop and fetch pages

Controls per-product iteration, routes to the completion endpoint when all rows are processed, and fetches the current product page HTML for each watchlist item.

## Validate fetch result

Checks whether the page fetch returned an API error; failures are formatted into an error record and sent to Slack, while successful HTML is cleaned for extraction.

## Extract and compare data

Uses an AI extraction model to pull price and stock information from the cleaned HTML, then compares those values with the last known values from the watchlist row.

## Detect notify changes

Determines whether the current price or availability differs from the stored values and sends a Slack notification when a change is found.

## Update watchlist row

Builds the updated watchlist fields and writes the latest price and availability back to Google Sheets before returning to the product loop.
